items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Peter Williams was a drum player or something like Adler.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was wondering about Peter Williams, who he played with.
Peter Williams was a drum player or something like Adler. Holding the drums off.

A little worse? Well I don't think they become much worse than you ever did. Well, we won't question you on that. What was it like being in Oklahoma? Well Oklahoma, it reminds me of it. See they've got a lot of them, and a lot of things. Well I'll tell you about, that's why I met Big Chief. You ever met Big Chief? Yeah I met him. The big Indian? Yeah. Yeah. Don't let him stand nobody's who tell you, set the bears on fire, you understand?
